LOAD-BEARING INVARIANTS proven: (1) no double count -- Pixel+CAPI of one source event build the SAME event_id (platform dedup) + internal dedup_key UNIQUE per platform (SMK-003/FAIL-001); (2) no raw PII in any external payload or result log -- fail-closed hash mechanism, verified via the built payload AND the result log (SMK-017/FAIL-008); leg 2 stays CONDITIONALLY BLOCKED on M6-OD-003 for the ratified field list (the MECHANISM is proven, the policy is the forward gate); (3) consent fail-closed at send (RULE-002/FAIL-002) hardened by F-A/F-B/F-C; (4) offline only after ORDER_VERIFIED (RULE-003/FAIL-001), fan-out + transport guard; (5) staged, no real send -- external_send=OFF, items held never SENT. (4.2) StagedPlatformTransport is the M6.2D wiring (builds+logs+blocks); event_id source-derived+shared; hash fail-closed.
